atmosphere: Late-night care becomes a tribunal without changing its gentle tone; the closed door, fatigue, witnesses, and project stakes turn accurate observations into pressure.
evaluation_obligations: Verify that romantic progress changes knowledge, trust, desire, choice, or future possibility.
Verify that suspense and romance are causally interlocked rather than parallel tracks.
Verify contemporary social and institutional plausibility.
Verify that faith causally shapes the romantic arc.
At book scope, verify that the central love story resolves in a credible durable union; do not demand this resolution from an opening scene.
Verify intelligible but non-clinical intimacy with narrative consequence.
At the appropriate scope, verify increasing capacity for durable covenant.
Judge the scene by its phase-specific relationship work.
Verify reciprocal causality between the romance and external plot.
Verify progression rather than repetitive deferral.
Verify rising danger and meaningful reversals.
Verify multiple live explanations and an evidence-changing control or revelation.
Verify that mechanisms are discoverable through action and that a smaller unexplained remainder can survive.
Verify that institutional structure changes what characters can safely say and do.
Verify that exclusivity is chosen and causally meaningful.
Verify agency, reciprocity, and revocability through action.
Verify character before mechanics and intimacy as relationship change.
Quote the action that generates attraction and identify what it reveals.
Verify that restraint changes relationship knowledge and does not merely end the scene.
Verify that proximity changes the relationship.
Verify that institutional proximity changes access, reputation, or choice.
Verify both the protective action and the remaining mystery.
Verify mutual obligation rather than instant group warmth.
Judge psychological pressure separately from consent and heat.
Verify a specific institutional mechanism of danger.
Verify contemporary material and social continuity.
Verify that technology is specific enough to affect action and worldview.
Verify that observation does not automatically justify interpretation and that no narrator settles the supernatural question prematurely.
Verify causal Christian practice rather than generic spiritual vocabulary.
Verify integration rather than suppression, fear, or disembodied sermon.
Verify that marriage is a causal vocation rather than a prudish reward.
Verify that grace neither denies responsibility nor makes redemption impossible.
Verify no sustained access to another character's unexpressed interiority.
Verify tense continuity.
Verify emotional seriousness without solemn abstraction.
Verify sustained forward pressure and earned uncertainty.
Verify concrete observation and a precise residual mystery.
Verify that the compound changes privacy, proximity, and status.
Verify both uncertainty and competence without generic genius.
Verify simultaneous skill, care, appetite, and limitation.
Verify the cost, protection, and romantic meaning of restraint.
Verify high embodied charge, preserved agency, no consummation, and a relationship-changing aftermath.
Verify that the action performs intimacy work without generic arousal or consummation.
Verify that the interruption creates a forward-driving question.
Verify a concrete post-contact relationship change.
Verify no consummation and no anticlimactic collapse.
Verify sensory precision and rhythm without purple excess.
Distinguish accumulating tension from stalled repetition.

prompt_obligations: Make romantic change causal rather than decorative.
Make danger, uncertainty, or investigation alter intimacy, trust, and romantic choice.
Ground attraction and impediment in contemporary institutions, language, and material life.
Make faith operate through attention, freedom, sacrifice, decision, and consequence rather than detachable exposition.
Make the central relationship structurally indispensable and direct the long arc toward a durable shared future.
When consummation occurs, prioritize emotional exchange, selective sensation, dialogue, and consequence over anatomical inventory.
Make marriage a progressively chosen form of shared life rather than a decorative epilogue.
Place each scene inside a legible phase of setup, adhesion, deepening, or resolution.
Make every major external turn alter romantic knowledge or choice, and every romantic turn alter the external problem.
Accumulate desire through specific recognition, impediment, and chosen restraint; every delay must produce new knowledge.
Escalate threat through causal revelations and costly choices.
Keep observation, interpretation, and mechanism separable while pressure rises.
Dramatize psychotechnology through observable cues, experiments, incentives, and residual uncertainty.
Express institutional incentives through behavior, access, ritual, and unequal social risk.
Build the central romantic future around mutual exclusive choice.
Make reciprocal choice and the live possibility of stopping increase intimacy and perception.
Sustain strong embodied charge and make any open-door intimacy perform emotional and narrative work.
Let attraction arise from witnessed skill, judgment, or costly restraint in action.
Make restraint active, socially or emotionally costly, and hotter because it increases freedom and perception.
Use repeated proximity to create new knowledge, choices, and costs.
Use institutional duties and observation to make encounters consequential.
Reveal protection through costly action while preserving an answerable question about motive or history.
Build belonging through reciprocal risk, work, hospitality, and repair.
Intensify uncertainty and attention while preserving legible agency.
Make institutional danger concrete through access, surveillance, incentives, and consequence.
Use contemporary technology, institutions, and social expectations consistently.
Ground the technology milieu in concrete work, status incentives, and epistemic conflict.
Keep ordinary and extraordinary explanations live; let a meaningful control collapse much of the effect while preserving a smaller honest remainder.
Express Christian faith through perception, prayer, action, freedom, responsibility, and grace.
Let chastity increase perception, freedom, delight, and capacity for truthful love.
Direct mature desire toward a freely chosen covenant that deepens embodied delight and responsibility.
Preserve agency, confession, restitution, consequence, forgiveness, and real change.
Filter perception, inference, desire, and uncertainty through one close third-person viewpoint.
Maintain unobtrusive past-tense narration.
Let sincerity coexist with wit and self-awareness.
End beats with sharpened questions, changed risks, or consequential decisions.
Make ordinary details newly strange without collapsing uncertainty into vagueness.
Use shared space, observation, access, and ritual to intensify institutional and romantic pressure.
Let inexperience coexist with real perception, method, and moral agency.
Make the mentor's care genuine and her acquisitiveness visible through changing tactics.
Reveal protection through costly restraint and specific action.
Build intense reciprocal attention through selective sensation, distance, interruption, and chosen restraint; do not consummate.
Give a nonsexual action erotic escalation, reciprocal attention, choice, emotional exchange, and a changed relationship state.
Let interruption intensify unresolved meaning rather than merely stop action.
Give intimacy an aftermath that changes interpretation, vulnerability, duty, or next action.
End the scene without consummation while delivering a complete emotional and relational turn.
Use coherent recurring sensory motifs rather than indiscriminate ornament.
Make each delayed advance produce recognition, trust, vulnerability, or a harder future choice.
relationship_result: Mara and Jonah explicitly practice a revocable doorway rule, share one mutually chosen kiss that stops while still desired, and end with hopeful future possibility rather than consummation or resolved courtship.
